landing.heroTitle: A place that belongs to the people in it.
landing.bsStand: Steppe is fiscally sponsored civic infrastructure for Central Oregon, being built for the members who will govern it.
landing.bsBrief: A founding beta for verified neighbors, designed to become a member-governed commons. The proposed guarantees are below.
landing.bsArt1B: The planned model uses member subscriptions instead of advertising, with the commitment carried into the founding documents before incorporation.
landing.bsArt2B: The beta will not accept residency proof until delete-after-review and orphan cleanup are verified end to end.
landing.bsArt3B: The founding model gives members binding votes on rules, budget, and leadership. The beta will test that governance before launch.
landing.bsArt4B: Account access, export, deletion, and session revocation are beta launch gates. Member data is never sold.
landing.bsExchSub: Posted by verified neighbors · newest first · nothing sorted for clicks
landing.bsCtaP: Steppe works once enough neighbors join to run it. Add your name to the record.
landing.step1B: Confirm you live in Central Oregon, a quick one-time check. Real neighbors only.
landing.step2B: The founding beta is free. Paid membership is planned at $4 a month afterward, with a no-questions hardship waiver.
landing.step3B: Join groups, post to the local exchange, ask for a hand and lend one, and get to know the people who actually live around you.
landing.step4B: Help decide the budget, the rules, and where Steppe goes next. Your ballot is secret. Everyone starts at 1×, votes count equally at launch, and weight accrues with tenure.
landing.isomimoAlt: Steppe gear emblem holding a high-desert landscape

partners.heroTitle: Civic infrastructure, built so it can't be sold.
partners.heroLead: Steppe is a fiscally sponsored civic project building community-governed digital infrastructure for Central Oregon. The first test is capped at 50 people. It advances to a 250-member launch, free for six months, only if 25 or more people participate and local-organization collaboration produces current, real-time local information.
partners.theoryTitle: Community life moved onto platforms that can be sold.
partners.theoryLead: The places neighbors gather online are owned by companies that monetize attention and can be acquired, shut down, or quietly degraded whenever it suits the owner. Steppe is built so none of that can happen here.
partners.s1B: Local connection now runs through extractive, ad-driven platforms with no accountability to the people who use them. They sell attention, harvest data, and can be sold out from under a community overnight.
partners.s2B: A fiscally sponsored beta building toward a member-governed public benefit nonprofit, with no equity to sell and its core promises carried into the founding documents for member ratification.
partners.s3B: Durable local civic infrastructure that belongs to the community itself. Always ad-free, privacy-respecting, and impossible to acquire or enshittify. All towns can adopt the same model and govern it themselves.
partners.guarTitle: Designed for the founding documents, then tested in beta.
partners.p1a: Planned Oregon public benefit nonprofit. No shareholders, investors, or equity exit.
partners.p1b: Mission and dissolution protections drafted for the articles of incorporation.
partners.p1c: No acquisition path in the planned structure. There is no equity to buy.
partners.p2b: Temporary residency proof, verified before beta
partners.p2d: Member data with tested export and deletion controls
partners.p3c: To amend a foundational rule, with 30-day notice
partners.p4h: Money flows back to the commons.
partners.p4a: Any surplus goes to a Community Fund, not to an owner.
partners.p4b: Members allocate it yearly by ranked-choice vote.
partners.fundTitle: How Steppe plans to pay its bills.
partners.fundLead: Ignite administers sponsor-routed grants, donations, and other sponsored responsibilities. Gregory Chism will administer member subscriptions directly; the planned model keeps subscriptions as the long-term operating anchor.
partners.duesDesc: $4 a month, flat, from verified residents. The base that keeps Steppe accountable to members first.
partners.grantsDesc: Project funding for connectivity and digital-equity work, aligned to mission and time-bound.
partners.donDesc: Voluntary contributions above base dues, from members and local supporters.
partners.earnedDesc: Mission-aligned services, like helping other communities stand up their own instances.
partners.govDesc: Public funds taken last and only with radical transparency, to protect independence.
partners.ask1B: Ignite is helping with the director search; additional introductions and independent governance expertise remain welcome.
partners.ask2B: Project funding for rural connectivity and digital-equity programs across Central Oregon.
partners.ask3B: Broadband-equity, education, and economic-development organizations building local digital capacity.
partners.ask4B: Towns that want civic infrastructure of their own and intend to govern it themselves.

join.term3B: An optional bit above dues helps cover waivers and the Community Fund. Always your choice, never expected.

privacy.heroTitle: We have nothing to gain from your data.
privacy.heroLead: Most platforms bury privacy in a menu. Steppe is building it into the beta: no ads, no behavioral trackers, and no business model that depends on your information.
privacy.cAB: Steppe's model does not sell member information. The beta is free; planned member subscriptions fund the service instead of advertising.
privacy.cBB: No third-party trackers, no advertising pixels, and no behavioral profiles. Nothing watches what you do in order to sell you something or to someone later.
privacy.cCH: Verification proof is temporary by design
privacy.cCB: The beta is not yet accepting residency proof. Before it does, deletion after review and orphan cleanup must be verified end to end. The retained record will contain only the verification result, date, and method. It will not contain the document or legal name.
privacy.cDH: Your profile is private by default
privacy.cDB: Every personal field starts hidden. You choose, one at a time, whether it is visible to no one or to all members. Your verification status stays visible. If you are a moderator, that role stays visible too.
privacy.cEB: The intended app limits a conversation to its two participants and gives moderators no message reader. Reliable account deletion and session revocation remain beta launch gates. A safety excerpt another participant chooses to report may remain as report intake.
privacy.cFH: Access, export, and deletion are launch gates
privacy.cFB: Before beta invitations, Steppe must verify that account export is complete, deletion removes ordinary account data and sent messages, sessions lose authority, and only minimized integrity records remain.
privacy.recordDek: Only what the beta needs to run a verified community designed for member governance. Nothing is kept “just in case.”
privacy.r1Cw: Your email is used to sign you in. You also choose a display name so neighbors know who they are talking to.
privacy.r1CrN: deletion must pass the beta gate
privacy.r2Cw: The beta is free. When paid membership begins, Gregory Chism will administer member subscriptions directly and the payment provider will be disclosed before collection starts.
privacy.r3Cw: The intended flow uses proof of local residence for one human decision, then deletes the proof and keeps only the result, date, and method. Collection stays closed until cleanup is verified.
privacy.r4Cw: Listings, messages, group activity, and votes. The intended deletion flow removes sent messages and anonymizes integrity-required voting and moderation records; that flow must pass security verification before beta.
privacy.r5Cw: Basic technical records to keep the service running and safe. No tracking profiles.
privacy.r5CrN: a technical limit must be verified
privacy.rSeeD: Review the account records covered by the beta access process.
privacy.rExportD: A complete, tested export is required before beta invitations.
privacy.rCorrectD: Fix anything that's wrong, any time.
privacy.rDeleteD: The beta cannot open until account deletion, message cleanup, and session revocation work together reliably.
privacy.closeP: This page describes the privacy behavior Steppe intends to verify before opening the beta, not a claim that every control is already production-ready. Gregory Chism handles member data. Ignite handles sponsored responsibilities other than member subscriptions, and either Gregory or Ignite may handle a contract when that contract names them. Residency-proof cleanup, complete export, account deletion, and session revocation remain launch gates. The full draft policy carries the formal detail.
privacy.legalGoverns: The full legal policy is available in English, and the English version governs.
